Windows' “Game Controllers” (joy.cpl) test page will show this pad in its list but will not show its buttons or axes moving. That page reads the old DirectInput API, which Xbox-type controllers — real ones included — don't report through. It's expected, and nothing is wrong. This monitor and your games both read the same XInput state the pad actually publishes.
